resultText:
- `out/card.mp4`: the finished title card, H.264 (High profile), 1080x1920, 30 fps, 6.000 s (180 frames), no audio track. "Ship Faster" slides up and fades in between 0.45 and 1.5 s, and "Faster" plus an underline bar are in `#FF5A1F`. A glowing gradient and diagonal stripes move in the background the whole time, and every frame differs from the one before it.
- `src/card.html`: the animation source. Every frame is computed from the timestamp alone.
- `src/scene.json`: the render settings used to make the video, so it can be rendered again.
- `out/export.json`: the render record, pointing to the raw render under `artifacts/slopcamera/generated/html-scenes/`.
- `out/stills/`, `out/check/sheet.png`: stills and a contact sheet I used to check the frames.

toolCalls.name: Bash
toolCalls.input: {"command":"slopcamera --help 2>&1 | head -60; slopcamera html --help 2>&1 | head -40","description":"Show slopcamera CLI help"}

toolCalls.name: Bash
toolCalls.input: {"command":"mkdir -p src out && slopcamera html scaffold plain --output src/card.html && cat src/card.html; ls src; slopcamera doctor --json | head -40","description":"Scaffold plain HTML scene and check doctor"}

toolCalls.name: Write
Bash
toolCalls.input: {"command":"slopcamera html still --input src/scene.json --at 0.3,1.0,3,5.9 --output out/stills 2>&1 | tail -5; ls out/stills","description":"Render review stills","timeout":300000}

toolCalls.name: Bash
toolCalls.input: {"command":"sed -i '' -e 's|rgb(255 90 31 / 55%)|rgb(255 90 31 / 30%)|' -e 's|rgb(255 170 60 / 30%)|rgb(255 170 60 / 16%)|' -e 's|letter-spacing: -0.04em;|letter-spacing: -0.04em;\\n  text-shadow: 0 12px 60px rgb(0 0 0 / 45%);|' src/card.html && grep -n \"30%)\\|16%)\\|text-shadow\" src/card.html && slopcamera html still --input src/scene.json --at 0.3,1.0,5.9 --output out/stills 2>&1 | tail -3","description":"Dim blobs, add shadow, re-render stills","timeout":300000}

toolCalls.name: Bash
toolCalls.input: {"command":"sed -i '' -e 's|padding: 0 0.06em 0.08em;|padding: 0.2em 0.3em;\\n  margin: -0.2em -0.3em;|' -e 's|text-shadow: 0 12px 60px rgb(0 0 0 / 45%);|text-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgb(0 0 0 / 40%);|' src/card.html && slopcamera html still --input src/scene.json --at 1.0,5.9 --output out/stills 2>&1 | tail -2","description":"Fix shadow clipping and re-render stills","timeout":300000}

toolCalls.name: Bash
toolCalls.input: {"command":"slopcamera html render --input src/scene.json --json > out/export.json 2> out/render.log; echo exit=$?; tail -3 out/render.log; python3 -c \"import json;d=json.load(open('out/export.json'));print(d.get('output'))\"","description":"Render full HTML scene to MP4","timeout":600000}

toolCalls.name: Bash
toolCalls.input: {"command":"S=artifacts/slopcamera/generated/html-scenes/html_5d1b38affe1b411798c6b9fbe9072a8e/video.mp4 && ffprobe -v error -show_entries stream=codec_type,codec_name,width,height,r_frame_rate,nb_frames,pix_fmt,duration -show_entries format=duration -of compact $S && ffmpeg -v error -y -i $S -map 0:v -c copy -an -movflags +faststart out/card.mp4 && ffprobe -v error -show_entries stream=codec_type,codec_name,profile,width,height,r_frame_rate,nb_frames,pix_fmt,duration -show_entries format=duration -of compact out/card.mp4","description":"Probe render, remux video-only to out/card.mp4"}

toolCalls.name: Bash
toolCalls.input: {"command":"mkdir -p out/check && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/card.mp4 -vf \"select='not(mod(n\\,30))+eq(n\\,179)',scale=270:480,tile=7x1\" -frames:v 1 -fps_mode vfr out/check/sheet.png && ffmpeg -v error -i out/card.mp4 -vf \"crop=1080:500:0:1400,signalstats,metadata=print:key=lavfi.signalstats.YAVG\" -f null - 2>&1 | grep -o 'YAVG=[0-9.]*' | awk 'NR%30==1'","description":"Build contact sheet and measure background luminance change"}

toolCalls.name: Bash
toolCalls.input: {"command":"ffmpeg -i out/card.mp4 -vf \"select='gte(n\\,1)',tblend=all_mode=difference,signalstats,metadata=print:key=lavfi.signalstats.YAVG:file=-\" -f null - 2>/dev/null | grep YAVG | awk -F= 'NR%20==1{print NR, $2}'","description":"Measure frame-to-frame difference over time"}
